title: Surprise Tatin
method: Boil whole baby potatoes in salted water 25 mins, drain and slice into 2cm discs.
Halve cherry tomatoes; slow roast at 130°C for 45 mins. Caramelise onions separately in oil.
Melt sugar and butter in a pan until semi-dark caramel; pour into base of lined 22cm cake tin.
Sprinkle oregano over caramel, pack potato slices upright, tuck onions and tomatoes into gaps, layer sliced goat's cheese.
Tuck puff pastry circle tightly over filling.
Bake at 200°C for 25 mins, then 180°C for 15 mins. Invert onto serving plate.
